trainers.finishSound: The Northern and Southern states had different opinions on the topic of slavery. The Southern states supported slavery, the Northern states didn't. In 1860, Abraham Lincoln became the 16th president of the United States. He was against slavery. The Southern states were afraid that Lincoln would ban slavery. That's why they parted from the United States and called themselves “Confederate States”. In 1861, the Civil War started and the Northern and Southern states fought against each other. In 1865, the Northern states won the war and as a result, African American slaves were freed.

atoms.text: On the 1st December 1955, Rosa Parks took the bus home after work. Like all POCs, Rosa had to sit in the back of the bus.
At the next stop, a white man entered the bus.
Because all seats on the bus were already taken, the bus driver told the POCs to give up their seats.
Rosa Parks refused to give up her seat.
The bus driver called the police and Rosa Parks was arrested.

atoms.a: What happened after Rosa Parks got arrested?
b: ++Civil Rights Movement leaders met and organised protests.
Bus drivers met and organised protests.

What happened after the Montgomery Bus Boycott?

The Supreme Court decided that the segregation laws in Alabama were constitutional.

atoms.b: On ((++September February)) 11th 2001, America was under a ((++terrorist tourist)) attack.
At 8:46 a.m. people in New York heard a ((++plane hot_air_balloon)) flying too low.
Just seconds later, this plane crashed into one of the ((++twin_towers sibling_towers)) of the ((++World_Trade_Center White_House)). 17 minutes later, another plane crashed into the second tower.
A ((++third fifth)) plane crashed into a part of the Pentagon, the headquarters of the U.S. Department of ((++Defense Finance)) in Washington D.C.
There was a fourth plane which was also flying towards ((++Washington_D.C. New_York)). Before it could reach the ((++Pentagon Pegasus)), it crashed into a field.
Each year, on the ((++11th_of_September 1st_of_May)), people in the USA remember the people who died during the terrorist attacks. This day is called “((++Patriot_Day Independence_Day))”.
